verdict.rationale: The Drive API v3 reference documents a dedicated `changes` resource ("A change to a file or shared drive"), which is the product's own change-feed surface for incremental sync instead of re-listing files. The evidence is only a single one-line reference entry, so how incremental retrieval actually works is not shown. Push notifications are a separate webhook capability and are not credited here. Missing for 10: documentation of the cursor/page-token mechanism (start token, next-token semantics), proof that only deltas since the last call are returned, coverage of deletions and shared-drive scope, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
